title: Evaluation of an AND node
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $cs$ be a list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables, and let $x$ be an assignment of Boolean values to those variables. The circuit consisting of an AND node with children $cs$ evaluates under $x$ to the same Boolean value as the conjunction of the evaluations of all circuits in $cs$.
hypotheses_covered: $cs$ is a list of circuit trees on $n$ variables
$x$ assigns a Boolean value to each of the $n$ variables
